annotations.title: Is this product category being recalled more?

description: Use when the user is weighing quality or supplier risk in a food, drug or device category, diligencing a manufacturer, or asks about recall history: "are ice cream recalls rising?", "who recalls the most peanut butter?". Returns FDA recall records per year from openFDA enforcement reports, the direction, the split by class (Class I is the most serious) and the firms with the most recalls. No recall in the window is a sound result. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For who is getting devices cleared in the category, use run_device_clearances.
